feature: A video no longer runs a picture's motion loop behind the timeline
summary: Opening a video with moving titles or zooms used to start the looping motion preview meant for animated pictures, which redrew the whole edit thirty times a second with nothing in the window to stop it. A video now plays its motion only under its own transport, so zooming the timeline of the hour-long edit just after opening it drops about half as many frames.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The button on step 1 opens your own copy of the 60 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev; File > Open reaches it too (Cmd-Shift-G, ~/Library/Caches/Photonz Reference Edit/Photonz Dev). Measured with a timeline-only speed walk on the probe, one build with a throwaway switch, three runs each way, alternating.

try.do: Open the 60 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev with the button below.
Straight away, press Backslash to see the whole hour.
Pinch the timeline in quickly, a few times.
Stop, and look at the picture above the transport.
Press Space to play, then Space again to stop.

evaluate: Does zooming in right after opening the hour-long edit feel smoother than before?
Does the picture above the transport sit still on the playhead's frame when nothing is playing?
Do titles and zooms still move as they should while the edit plays?
rough: Numbers, 60 minute edit, one build, throwaway switch, three alternating runs each way (load about 5 to 10): zoom in late frames 44/45/48 to 19/20/22 of 240, mean frame 10.19/10.04/10.13 to 8.93/9.18/9.06 ms, p95 20.9/19.9/18.7 to 14.1/15.6/16.0 ms, main thread 6.4/6.1/6.2 to 4.9/5.0/4.9 ms a frame. Near Fit, zoom out and scroll unchanged (the loop had already ended by then): near Fit 84/82/71 to 76/77/75 late of 648.
Found with the every-pass profile: 460 samples of zoom in's passes sat in the motion loop's redraw of the whole document, up to 5.5 ms in one pass.
The Motion section's play button, if a person turns that section on for a video, is now dimmed there: a video plays with Space and the transport.

Bars of the task not reached: near Fit still about 12 per cent of frames late (the frames that let go of a held painting), zoom in about 20 of 240 (8 per cent against 5), edits (owned by a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed). The task stays open.
